Note: 1. With the M type, the exposed contact lances from the N type are covered by resin which is integrally formed and molded into the housing body
         as a single unit, further improving electrical safety.
      2. Please note that the retainer mountable type housing for 2 circuits can only be used with the standard type header. It cannot be used with
         the shrouded type header.
      3. For flame retardant grade of resin material used, please refer to the "List of Registered Overseas Standards" on our website
        (listed in the “Technical Documents” column on the Product Information page).
